executive_summary: Your supplier base is vulnerable to cascading geopolitical shocks rather than isolated failures. Six of your ten flagged suppliers operate in or depend on the US-China trade corridor (Huizhou BYD, Smoore, EVE Energy, IP Sun, Porton, ITC), creating correlated risk across your critical EMS, battery, and nicotine categories. This is the genuine near-term threat: export controls or tariff escalation would simultaneously compress electronics manufacturing capacity and raw material sourcing. GPI's unexplained 3.4% stock decline warrants a direct check-in on production capacity, since it's your only high-BAT packager and lacks geopolitical cover. Secondary but manageable: Stora Enso (Finland) and Sappi (South Africa) face regional headwinds that are slower-moving, while Tae Young Filters' Korean exposure is lower-probability than China-US friction. Prioritize contingency conversations with your EMS and battery suppliers this week; defer Stora Enso and Sappi reviews to next month unless new escalation signals emerge.
